title: Irishima’s vein
desc: Why Kagurabachi’s war is a fight over a quarter-ton of rock, and why Part 2 has to smelt it in public.
text: About 250 kilograms of Datenseki are known. One pair of eyes ever made it safe. title: The leak as policy
desc: Kasen did not slip. He hired a method. Why a director leaking a smith’s address is the Kamunabi’s original sin in the present tense.
text: Kasen is director. Long beard. Barriers and sealing. He sealed Shinuchi with Ichiki and Yatsuru after the war. He laments that major sorcery clans will not respect a bureau. He believes Enchanted Blades can create order. He conspired with the Hishaku and leaked Kunishige ’s location. Three of the ten walked into the workshop. The smith died in front of the son. The six wartime blades left. Enten stayed. The present tense is a three-year commute away from that memo. This is not a slip. A slip is a drunk clerk. title: Enchanted Blades in Kagurabachi
desc: The seven Enchanted Blades of Kagurabachi: Enten, Cloud Gouger, Magatsumi, Kumeyuri, Tobimune, and the two still unnamed in publication.
text: An Enchanted Blade (妖刀, yōtō) does not “cast” so much as overfill. Spirit energy becomes too large for the body and leaves as a shape, goldfish, clouds, flowers, feathers, oiran, that can be steered, seen through, and charged into the steel so the bearer can spend techniques while empty-handed. The swords share a kanji with sorcery (妖術, yōjutsu). The difference is that the art left the body and did not come back. Kunishige cut seven of them from Datenseki . Six won a war. Official trailers still sell all three behind the coat. Craft: goldfish, not koi . Furniture: the bowl . Steel: Enten . Hishaku flame Ten criminal sorcerers. Flame tattoos. Shared fire-gate. The mark is the membership card; the gate is the clause. Yura is the mind, not the loudest killer in the set

text: An Enchanted Blade overfills. Spirit energy leaves the body as a shape that can be steered, seen through, and charged back into the steel so the bearer can spend techniques empty-handed. It is the brief, meant: the wielder’s intent locking with the steel until the kit grows an extension. Dark power (Kuroi chikara) is what happens when that lock happens at the edge of death, or when the blade itself is dying. The color goes black. The output jumps. Mei: Shred. Suzaku’s black flames.
